name: Radar
description: The Lighthouse shop upgrade that reveals unlocked island coordinates as colored markers.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot showing the boat and island navigation environment

sections.heading: What the markers mean
paragraphs: Buy the Radar for $10 before leaving the Lighthouse. Story hand-ins add the next destination to it: Forest is green, Desert yellow, Rocks red and Volcano pink.
bullets: A marker only appears after the relevant trophy or quest item is handed in.
Use the compass heading and marker together while sailing.
The Radar reveals destinations; it does not replace the boat key.

name: Beer → Empty Beer Can
description: The first multi-step item chain: give the beer to the Lighthouse Keeper, then use the empty can for Spider Crab.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Lighthouse quest area

sections.heading: Exact route
bullets: Obtain a Beer and give it to the Lighthouse Keeper.
Keep the returned Empty Beer Can.
Equip it with the Crab Fishing Rod to summon Spider Crab.
Return the required crab result to receive the boat key.

name: Leech Bait
description: The one-use story bait obtained by returning three ground-spawned leeches to the lady by the Forest lake. The inventory name is Leech Bait.
imageAlt: Game-derived low-poly Leech Bait model from How to Fish

sections.heading: How to obtain and use it
bullets: Pick up three leeches from the ground; they are not rod catches.
Give all three to the lady by the lake.
Confirm that Leech Bait appears in inventory.
Use it to summon Giant Piranha, then return the boss trophy.

name: Carrot
description: The Pufferfish bait received by trading an eligible endangered creature to the tourist on Desert Island.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Desert Island Pufferfish encounter

sections.heading: Endangered-creature trade
bullets: Buy the $15 Standard Lure.
Catch an eligible endangered creature; Needlefish and Seahorse are confirmed options.
Give the eligible catch to the tourist under the tree for the Carrot.
Use the Carrot for Pufferfish and return the fin to unlock Rocks Island.

name: Fish Bucket / Whale Bait
description: The late-game bait label used in launch walkthroughs for the Bowhead Whale step of the final encounter chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of a late-game island and equipment

sections.heading: How it fits the final chain
paragraphs: The item is also called Whale Bait in route descriptions; use the current inventory label shown in Tab.
bullets: Bring the scientist five requested fish to receive the whale trigger.
Use it for Bowhead Whale.
Do not sell or cook the defeated whale.
Carry the defeated whale to the volcano to trigger the mutated encounter.

name: Boat Engine Upgrades
description: Boat engine tiers reduce travel time; reaching the highest tier unlocks the official I am speed achievement.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the boat beside an island

sections.heading: Upgrade route
paragraphs: Boat engine tiers reduce travel time between Radar markers and the highest tier completes the engine upgrade chain.
bullets: Upgrade when travel time begins to slow progression.
The benefit applies to solo and co-op routes.
The final tier unlocks I am speed.
